text: Mood [Lat. modus ]: Ger. Stimmung ; Fr. humeur ; Ital. umore . Pronounced emotional tone not connected with particular mental objects, and having much colouring from organic sensations. Literature : STOUT, Manual of Psychol., 286 f.; the titles given under EMOTION, and in BIBLIOG. G, 2, k . ( J.M.B. , G.F.S. )
